chapters.label: Durban, 2010
chapters.text: Durban, 2010, the World Cup semi-final. Spain, in red, play Germany, in white. Nil-nil, seventy-three minutes. Xavi whips in a corner... and Carles Puyol thunders a header into the net!

chapters.label: The long run
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Puyol starts far from goal, away from the grabbing arms. Then he charges in at full speed.

chapters.label: Highest point
chapters.text: He leaps above everyone and meets the ball at its highest point. Neuer has no chance!

chapters.label: Attack the ball
chapters.text: To beat taller defenders, make a long, brave run. Attack the ball at its highest point, and head it hard!
